mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong demand in the housing market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where HOUST > 1.5 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances during a tightening cycle.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 2% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where RSAFS MoM > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy with a strong labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: tight monetary policy with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns remain positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and UNRATE < 5%.
